name: Ecumenical Hunger Program Donations
description: Accepts donations of clothing, linens, household items, food, and furniture; serves East Palo Alto and neighboring communities; donation pick-up can be scheduled online
fullDescription: The Ecumenical Hunger Program (EHP) accepts donations of clothing, household items, food, and furniture to support its food and basic-needs services for low-income families in East Palo Alto and surrounding communities.
whatTheyOffer:
- Accept clean, gently used clothing and linens (bedding and linens especially needed)
- Accept household items
- Accept food and new items such as toys
- Accept furniture (call first)
- Online form to schedule a donation pick-up
- Supports community food programs
howToGetIt:
1. Drop off donations Monday-Thursday, 9am-5pm
2. Make sure clothing and linens are clean and gently used
3. For furniture, call (650) 323-7781 x1100 to see if it can be accepted
4. Or schedule a donation pick-up on the EHP website
5. Donations support local families
6. Hours may change around the holidays; call ahead
address: 2411 Pulgas Avenue, East Palo Alto, CA 94303
keywords: EHP, Ecumenical Hunger Program, East Palo Alto, donate clothes, donate furniture, household donation, clothing donation, pickup, charity donation, low-income support
